Overview

Popayán is a city in CA with a population of 280,000. The White City of Colombia, famous for its well-preserved colonial architecture and Holy Week processions. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
